event_limitations: CodeRED initiation and re-call times are not evacuation-order request times.
The source does not prove each resident received a message or departed.
Named zones and places remain ungeocoded until 2017 zone polygons are acquired.
The event layer is partial: road access and other alerts are not yet included.
limitations: OSM is community mapped and may omit roads or 2018 access restrictions.
Service roads are excluded until an egress role is verified.
Unknown directional lane counts and speeds remain null.
Exit nodes are geometric boundary crossings; destination names are unknown.
